[[File:Lutz Feld.jpg|thumb|Lutz Feld, 2012]]
'''Lutz Feld''' (born 25 July 1967 in [[Eitorf]], Germany) is a German [[physicist]] at [[RWTH Aachen University]].

Having studied physics in Bonn, Germany, Prof Lutz Feld wrote his [[Dissertation]] at [[Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron]] (German Electrons Synchrotron) in Hamburg, Germany. After being a [[Fellow]] at CERN, Geneva, Switzerland he habilitated in Freiburg (Breisgau), Germany. 
Since 2004, Feld has the title of a [[professor]] at [[RWTH Aachen University]] with the main research field [[particle physics]].<ref name="I. Physikalisches Institut B, RWTH Aachen">{{Cite web |url = http://accms04.physik.rwth-aachen.de/Welcome.html |title = I. Physikalisches Institut B RWTH Aachen Sommerfeldstr. 14, D-52074 Aachen}}</ref>
